snippet.title: Beat The Markets - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Beat The Markets is a turn-based digital board game based on investing in the stock market. Play with 2 - 6 players in this competitive financially based game inspired by 80s style board games and family game night. Players will buy investments and sell them to gain capital and sabotage their opponents with cards. Play is based on dice rolling and cards.

Wishlist The Game Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2095440/Beat_The_Markets/

Features:
- Local Multiplayer
- Online Multiplayer
- Steam Achievements
- Leaderboards
